transcript: A mistake... okay. So one time I sent a customer the wrong renewal date. I was copying details from our system into an email template and I, uh, I took the date from a different account that was open in the other tab. The customer thought they had another month, and then they got invoiced and they were quite upset, they thought we were trying to trick them. My manager found out when the customer called in. I apologised to the customer, I explained it was my error, and we gave them a small credit, which my manager approved. After that, I, um, I started closing all other tabs before writing to a customer, which sounds silly but it helped. I also asked if we could have the template pull the date automatically, but that didn't happen, the tools team was busy. The main lesson for me was to double check anything with a date or a number before I send it, because those are the things customers really remember. It hasn't happened again, as far as I know. I'm more careful now, especially at the end of the day when I'm tired and rushing.
